# Frontend Rigor & Quality Checklist: Flora Seed v0.1

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation for Svelte 5 frontend strictness, TypeScript, testing, telemetry, and deployment.
**Created**: 2026-08-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the TypeScript strictness requirements (`strict: true`, no `any`) fully documented for the Svelte 5 frontend? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK002 Are the specific testing framework tools (e.g., Vitest, Playwright) and required coverage thresholds documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec detail the specific `eslint-plugin-unicorn` rules required to match the rigor of `clippy::pedantic`? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are the specific JSON structure requirements for the Svelte 5 logger utility defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK005 Are the deployment configuration requirements (e.g., Coolify build steps for Svelte 5) fully specified? [Gap]
- [x] CHK006 Are the OpenTelemetry Collector integration points and network endpoints specified for the batch-sending Rust Axum endpoint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the "Definition of Done" for Test-Driven Development (TDD) quantified with specific test scenarios and metrics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Are the requirements for "explicitly and gracefully handling all Promises" clear enough for implementation (e.g., specifying standard error UI components)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is the term "batch-send" quantified with specific buffering times or payload size limits for the logger utility? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK010 Are the requirements for resolving `svelte-check` warnings clear enough to prevent the usage of `#ignore` comments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the client-side pre-flight file size checks consistent with the API gateway's 50MB limit behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Do the Svelte 5 Runes state management requirements align with the hybrid read-only mode triggered during token refresh? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for when the batch-sending logger endpoint is completely unreachable? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK014 Are the fallback UI requirements specified when a critical Promise (e.g., initial state fetch) fails? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec address how local draft states are safely persisted and retrieved during the 5-minute offline grace period without data loss? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK016 Are the specific local development configurations required to test against the real offline Rust backend (SQLite) documented? [Dependency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK017 Is the assumption of "modern browsers" quantified with specific browser versions (e.g., Chrome >= 100)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
